mutant.lineText: for (const l of all.filter((e) => e.tag === 'ul' || e.tag === 'ol')) if (l.children.some((c) => c.type === 'element' && !['li', 'script', 'template'].includes(c.tag))) add(l, 'list-children', 'minor', '1.3.1', 'A list may contain only li elements directly.');
